question: Who among the following is a Sarod player popularly known as 'Sarod Samrat'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Amjad Ali Khan Bangash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan Bangash** is an Indian classical musician known for his virtuosity in playing the Sarod.
 
• He is popularly known as the **'Sarod Samrat'** (Emperor of the Sarod).
 
• He belongs to the illustrious Bangash lineage, which has significantly contributed to Indian classical music.
 
• Ustad Amjad Ali Khan has been honored with several prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, one of India's highest civilian honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarod:**

 
 
• The Sarod is a stringed musical instrument, used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its deep, weighty, introspective sound, and is a prominent instrument in Hindustani classical music.
 
• The Sarod is believed to have evolved from the ancient Afghan Rabab, and its current form was given by Ustad Amjad Ali Khan's ancestors.
 
• The Sarod has a fretless fingerboard and is played with a plectrum called a 'jawa'.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan's Contributions:**
 
 
• Ustad Amjad Ali Khan has redefined the Sarod and its techniques, making it accessible to a global audience.
 
• He has performed in various prestigious venues worldwide, contributing to the global appreciation of Indian classical music.
 
• He has also collaborated with several international artists, blending Indian classical music with other genres.
 
• His efforts in music education, through workshops and lectures, have inspired many young musicians.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Indian Classical Musicians:**
 
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar:** A legendary Sitar player who popularized Indian classical music in the West.
 
• **Pandit Kishan Maharaj:** A renowned Tabla player known for his dexterity and rhythmic innovations.
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma:** A famous Santoor player who brought the instrument to the forefront of Indian classical music.
